WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT
    o.observstation,
    o.lunarstage,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM observatories AS o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage
), phase_counts AS (
  SELECT lunarstage, COUNT(*) AS station_count
  FROM station_averages
  GROUP BY lunarstage
)
SELECT
  pc.lunarstage,
  AVG(sa.avg_bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
  pc.station_count,
  pc.station_count * 1.0 / SUM(pc.station_count) OVER () AS station_fraction
FROM phase_counts AS pc
JOIN station_averages AS sa
  ON sa.lunarstage IS NOT DISTINCT FROM pc.lunarstage
GROUP BY pc.lunarstage, pc.station_count
